label: Bar stool with a cream upholstered shell, slim tapered wooden legs and a black footrest ring

source.description: The owner's picture: a modern bar stool, the seat and a curved back in one cream upholstered shell, on four slim tapered legs in a light wood finish and with a black square footrest ring. The picture has no sizes: the seat at 75 cm is the first stool's, the rest (46 cm wide, 45 deep, 1.00 m tall) is estimated.
